title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: US stocks trade lower as AI stocks decline, oil prices rise - The Economic Times
text:
US Market | Dow Jones Live Updates: Wall Street opens lower on Tuesday as renewed weakness in AI-linked stocks and higher oil prices weigh on the major indexes. The Dow Jones falls 0.01%, while the S&P 500 slips 0.15% and the Nasdaq drops 0.37% as investors await key corporate earnings this week.

- Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi at UBS Chief Investment Office
